sampling_plan.selection_rule: Single constructed record for deterministic contract testing; not a market sample.

first_principles_lane.transaction_model: A transaction requires a buyer, a costly or desired state change, a credible solution, and voluntary exchange.
first_principles_lane.human_desire: Reduce repetitive effort and uncertainty while preserving control over a deliverable.
invariants: A complaint is evidence of friction, not proof of willingness to pay.
A solution is valuable only if it improves the buyer's alternative after switching and adoption costs.
assumptions: The repeated task matters enough to change behavior.
The buyer can evaluate a bounded result without exposing sensitive data.

observation_lane.utterance: I keep copying customer comments into a weekly summary and fixing the same formatting every Friday.
observation_lane.behavioral_signal: The synthetic actor reports repeated manual work and a recurring cadence.
counterevidence: No observed purchase, search, migration, or commitment exists.

need_hypothesis.candidate_buyer: A person responsible for recurring customer-feedback summaries.
need_hypothesis.job_to_be_done: Turn authorized feedback records into a consistent reviewable summary with less repetitive formatting.
need_hypothesis.statement: Some people with this repeated workflow may value a bounded local transformation that preserves review control.
competing_explanations: The complaint may be casual venting with no intent to change.
The task may be infrequent or too low-cost to justify switching.
A spreadsheet template may already be sufficient.
need_hypothesis.weakest_assumption: The recurring friction is costly enough to produce observable evaluation behavior.

experiment_draft.method: After a new rights and outreach authorization, offer a local redacted sample transformation and observe whether the intended buyer supplies a sample or schedules an evaluation.
experiment_draft.success_signal: The intended buyer takes a predeclared costly evaluation action on an authorized sample.
experiment_draft.failure_signal: The intended buyer declines, does not act, or prefers the current workaround under the predeclared observation window.

evaluation_contract.oracle: Exact canonical output hash and preserved all-authority-false boundary.
evaluation_contract.human_baseline: Manually copy the same synthetic record into the target schema.
evaluation_contract.cost_record: No external spend; local deterministic evaluation only.
